summary: The provider Jenkinsfile's new Vet and unit tests stage runs go vet and go test (TF_ACC unset) in the go container after the header install and before publish, so a failure stops the registry append. No blocking findings. One advisory: the done-record says the build log shows TestAcc* skips, but non-verbose go test prints only per-package ok lines.

findings.summary: P3's Later-phases note says the build log shows unit tests passing and TestAcc* skipping; `go test ./...` without -v prints only `ok <pkg>` lines
